quote.text: Whoever wants to be free, therefore, let him not want or avoid anything that is up to others. Otherwise he will necessarily be a slave.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that true freedom for both you and your children is found in accepting what lies within your shared influence—guide them instead of controlling every element of their development.
    • Practice letting go of the need to secure every outcome; by encouraging independence and resilience, you allow your children to grow into self-reliant individuals.
  • Leadership
    • Embrace the perspective that effective leadership comes from focusing on what you can directly affect; by releasing attachment to factors beyond your control, you empower your team to act with autonomy.
    • Foster an environment where accountability is shared, and understand that seeking complete control hampers creativity and growth—true leaders inspire freedom within their ranks.
  • Product Management
    • In managing products, learn to distinguish between elements in your domain and those dictated by external market forces; success lies in innovating within what you can control.
    • Avoid micromanaging factors beyond the product team's influence; instead, concentrate on building a resilient strategy that adapts to change while maintaining clarity in your vision.
